blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) is mobilizing teachers, tutors, and parents nationwide to strengthen mathematics learning recovery through the Academic Recovery and Accessible Learning (ARAL) Mathematics Program. Under DepEd Memorandum No. 060, s. 2026, ARAL Mathematics will be implemented in public elementary and secondary schools for grades 1 through 10 beginning in the school year 2026-2027, according to a DepEd statement on Wednesday. The program uses assessment results to identify students who require support and provides structured, practice-based, and self-paced tutoring to help them achieve grade-level mathematics proficiency.
